properties.status: Louisiana was a distinct part of New France. These source polygons show selected settlements and claims, not its full extent or continuous effective control.

Northern North American coverage of New France. Canada, Acadia and Louisiana had distinct histories; the Louisiana components are shown separately. France ceded Canada to Britain in 1763. These simplified source extents do not establish continuous French control or Indigenous sovereignty.

This source aggregates distinct French colonial possessions outside the northern New France records. From 1763 it must not be read as French Canada. Some components retain outdated colonial extents; local control and transfer dates are not independently verified by this aggregate.
